messages:
Emily: quick heads-up — there's an unclaimed package at the front desk labeled "ACME - swag" from UPS, arrived 10:12am. anyone expecting this? :package:
frontdesk-bot: [Automated] Package received: ACME - SWAG. Stored in Locker #3. Holding for 48h. Tag: "no recipient on file".
Raj: hmm I think that's for Jordan's demo kit? Jordan mentioned acc reps earlier. Jordan — can you confirm?
Jordan: yep that's mine. i told ops someone would grab it but then hopped on a call. i'll swing by at lunch (around 12:30). can someone save the small couch in the lobby for two guests at 2:45pm? bringing an external PM.
Maria: can we avoid the teal couch? it's where the new plant sits, and it's currently a disaster zone :sweat_smile:
Devon: i can move the plant to the bench near devex if needed. also happy to pick up the package at 12:15 en route.
Emily: thanks Devon — can you also leave a quick sticky note on the package so frontdesk knows it's claimed? i'll prep a guest badge for Jordan's visitors (name on booking?).
Jordan: names are Olivia Chen and Mark Reyes — 2 people. thanks!
frontdesk-bot: Badge reservation created: Olivia Chen, Mark Reyes. Badge pickup: Front Desk. Expiry: 4 hours. Command logged: `create-guest-badge --names "Olivia Chen, Mark Reyes" --holder Jordan`
Emily: perfect. Devon — if you grab the pkg, could you drop it in Meeting Room A and write "Jordan demos" on the box? saves frontdesk time.
Devon: on it. i'll move plant and place package in MRA. leaving a note.
Maria: also — FYI the projector cart is booked 2:30-3:30. Jordan, should we move client spot to the right side of the lobby (near whiteboard) so they can plug in?
Jordan: yes please. right side is fine. thanks for flagging projector booking.
Raj: tagging facilities: @facilities if someone can fetch an extra folding chair? we might need one.
Emily: i'll ping facilities channel too. :+1:
Devon: package stashed in Meeting Room A and labeled. plant moved to devex bench. left note on front desk.
frontdesk-bot: Update: Package status changed to "claimed" by Devon at 12:18pm. Badge status: ready.
Jordan: you rock, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Maria: yay smooth ops :tada:
Emily: all set from people-ops side — badges printed, lobby seating noted, package locked in MRA. closing loop. :white_check_mark:
